title: Allow nested rope params for tiny models

target.summary: Using `isdisjoint` to detect nested `rope_parameters` treats any dictionary that contains at least one layer-type key as nested. When a checkpoint defines shared non-dictionary parameters alongside layer types, `validate_rope` assumes all top-level entries are nested configuration dictionaries and crashes with an `AttributeError`.
notes: faulty statement using isdisjoint to classify rope_parameters as nested when any layer-type key matches
same faulty isdisjoint check in validate_rope causing AttributeError on shared non-dictionary parameters
